facts.title: unlumen UI – Beautifully Designed React Components
facts.description: A curated registry of beautifully designed React components built with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Motion. Install with the shadcn CLI, customize freely, and ship production-ready interfaces faster.
facts.keywords: unlumen UI,Unlumen,React components,TypeScript,Tailwind CSS,Framer Motion,shadcn registry,shadcn CLI,UI components,Design system,Open-source UI

research.name: unlumen UI
research.note: React and shadcn registry of motion components and primitives built with Tailwind and Motion, with open free items and paid Pro ones.

effects: Stacked Feature Cards that fan in 3D

unverified: Free components and docs are public in leovvx/unlumen-ui-docs (MIT, 74 stars, last commit 2026-08-01); that repository has not yet been researched as a repository entry.
